“The book reads you back” keeps only the items below, in this book\'s assist file on this phone. They are counters per page: no text of the book, no picture and no face data. No video is saved or sent. The file leaves this phone only through your own sync, if you set one up. The AI gets a passage only when you tap a tab of “Say it another way?”.
